name: Candy Coated BITEZ Gummies 500mg Baggiez | Delta-9 | Blue Razz
description: Blue Raspberry gets the full candy-coated treatment. Blue Razz Candy Coated Double-Stacked Delta-9 BITEZ burst with that classic blue raspberry combination of juicy berry sweetness and mouth-puckering tartness, wrapped in a layer of tiny, colorful crunchy candies. Beneath the crunch are two soft, chewy gummy layers with 50mg of hemp-derived Delta-9 THC in each gummy, bringing tangy flavor, candy crunch, satisfying chew, and Delta-9 together in every bite.
